The Mazda Cosmo family

2 generations and variants in the Index, 1967–1995. Oldest first; every card opens the full page, with its own versions, figures and story.

  1. 1967–1968

    Mazda Cosmo Sport (Series I)

    Mazda's first rotary car and the world's first production car with a twin-rotor engine, built by hand in a run of just 343. Light, fast-revving and unlike anything else from Japan in 1967, it proved the Wankel could be made to last.

    108 hp8.8 sec 0-60115 mph top343 built
  2. 1990–1995

    Eunos Cosmo

    The only production car ever powered by a three-rotor rotary, wrapped in a long, quiet luxury coupe with a color GPS touchscreen years ahead of its time. Built for Japan's boom years and launched just as the boom ended, it remains Mazda's most extravagant road car.

    276 hp6.5 sec 0-60158 mph top8,875 built
